old_derivation: done = stories parsed out of `aisef status` whose column reads 'done'
why: `aisef status` lists only stories that are NOT passing, so the old set is empty however many stories are done
consequence: the W1 exit rule `owners and all(o in done for o in owners)` could not fire on any partial run: false_pass would read 0 for a reason unrelated to whether a false pass happened
